create_scenario_config: create a crime and punishment scenario config with a custom time period in minutes
run_simulation: run the crime and punishment simulation with a given model and embedder for a set number of steps
run_simulation_with_overrides: run the crime and punishment simulation with separate agent and game master model overrides
review_scenario_info: review the SCENARIO_INFO dict to get the scenario name, description, and entry point functions
review_create_scenario: review the create_scenario function to understand the locations, characters, and game rules for the simulation
